source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> BOOTING
    BOOTING --> ERROR: integrity fail
    ERROR --> BOOTING: retry
    BOOTING --> READY: compatible baseline
    READY --> PLAYER_HOME: Игрок
    READY --> GM_HOME: Мастер
    PLAYER_HOME --> READY: сменить режим
    GM_HOME --> READY: сменить режим
title: Выбор роли и разные главные меню

source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> DRAFT
    DRAFT --> METHOD: новый персонаж
    METHOD --> IDENTITY: способ и симбионты
    IDENTITY --> STATS: имя, описание, арт
    STATS --> SKILLS: семь характеристик
    SKILLS --> INVENTORY: навыки
    INVENTORY --> REVIEW: имущество и масса
    REVIEW --> FINAL: проверки пройдены
    FINAL --> EXPORTED: экспорт
    FINAL --> VARIANT: создать вариант
    VARIANT --> DRAFT
title: Создание и локальный lifecycle персонажа

source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> LOCAL_SHEET
    LOCAL_SHEET --> CANDIDATE: игрок предлагает snapshot
    CANDIDATE --> GM_REVIEW: batch 1..3
    GM_REVIEW --> DECLINED: причина
    GM_REVIEW --> PROPOSED: atomic campaign copies
    PROPOSED --> DECLINED: игрок отклонил diff
    PROPOSED --> ACTIVE: игрок принял и capacity valid
    ACTIVE --> ARCHIVED: кампания завершена
title: Заявка, рассмотрение и допуск кампанийной копии

source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> DEVICE
    DEVICE --> ORDINARY: player launch
    DEVICE --> HOST: master launch
    ORDINARY --> P0: 0 admitted
    P0 --> P1: add player
    P1 --> P2: add player
    P2 --> P3: add player
    HOST --> GM_ONLY: 0 local players
    GM_ONLY --> GM_P1: provisional claim admitted
    GM_P1 --> GM_P2: add player
    GM_P2 --> GM_P3: add player
    P3 --> LIMIT: fourth rejected
    GM_P3 --> LIMIT: fourth rejected
title: Локальные seats обычного ПК и host-компьютера

source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> IDENTITY
    IDENTITY --> SCHEMA: раса, класс, анатомия
    SCHEMA --> STATS: семь ручных stats
    STATS --> SYMBIONTS: без лимита суммы
    SYMBIONTS --> SKILLS
    SKILLS --> INVENTORY
    INVENTORY --> STATE: HP, OE, effects
    STATE --> REVIEW
    REVIEW --> V1: atomic save
    V1 --> V_NEXT: новая версия
    V_NEXT --> ARCHIVED: archive
    V1 --> BLOCKED_DELETE: active reference
title: Создание и версионирование НПС

source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> CATALOG
    CATALOG --> SENTIENT_DRAFT: враг-мыслящий
    CATALOG --> MONSTER_DRAFT: произвольный монстр
    SENTIENT_DRAFT --> SENTIENT_REVIEW: полная персонажная схема
    MONSTER_DRAFT --> MONSTER_REVIEW: строгая схема монстра
    SENTIENT_REVIEW --> TEMPLATE_V1: save
    MONSTER_REVIEW --> TEMPLATE_V1: save
    TEMPLATE_V1 --> TEMPLATE_NEXT: новая версия
    TEMPLATE_V1 --> RUNTIME_COPY: добавить в бой
    RUNTIME_COPY --> TEMPLATE_V1: template unchanged
title: Создание и версионирование врага и монстра

source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> REQUESTED
    REQUESTED --> PLANNED: GM participants and watches
    REQUESTED --> DECLINED: GM reason
    PLANNED --> RUNNING: start
    RUNNING --> INTERRUPTED: event or combat
    INTERRUPTED --> RUNNING: GM resume and restart segments
    INTERRUPTED --> CANCELLED: GM cancel
    RUNNING --> COMPLETE: accumulated 240 minutes
    COMPLETE --> COOLDOWN: apply ordered full-rest effects
title: Длительный отдых

source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> DRAFT
    DRAFT --> PREFLIGHT: sides, actors, positions, visibility
    PREFLIGHT --> ACTIVE: Start and freeze world time
    ACTIVE --> AMBUSH: optional preinitiative scene
    ACTIVE --> INITIATIVE: no ambush
    AMBUSH --> INITIATIVE: scene resolved
    INITIATIVE --> TURN: fixed strip built
    TURN --> COMMAND: available action declared
    COMMAND --> ROLL: request or accelerated same-command packet
    ROLL --> RESOLVE: roll chain complete
    RESOLVE --> TURN: next actor
    TURN --> FINISH: GM result
    FINISH --> LOOT: eligible player victory
    FINISH --> DISPOSITION: no loot
    LOOT --> DISPOSITION
    DISPOSITION --> CLOSED
title: Полный lifecycle боя и актора

source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> CONNECTED
    CONNECTED --> LOST: heartbeat timeout
    LOST --> RECONNECTING: network available
    RECONNECTING --> RECONCILING: identity accepted
    RECONCILING --> CONFLICT: local command differs
    RECONCILING --> RESTORED: server snapshot and receipt
    CONFLICT --> RESTORED: server state accepted
    RESTORED --> CONNECTED
title: Потеря связи и reconnect

source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> CALCULATE
    CALCULATE --> EMPTY: no executable command
    CALCULATE --> PROJECTED: allowed actions only
    PROJECTED --> REQUEST: consent or master predicate
    PROJECTED --> REVALIDATE: direct executable intent
    REQUEST --> CALCULATE: denied or state changed
    REQUEST --> REVALIDATE: positive linked response
    REVALIDATE --> STALE: revision or guard changed
    REVALIDATE --> COMMITTED: atomic write
    STALE --> CALCULATE
    COMMITTED --> CALCULATE
title: Authoritative availableActions

source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> OWNER_DEAD
    OWNER_DEAD --> OUTSIDE_BODY: confirmed exit
    OUTSIDE_BODY --> CAPTURE: eligible body and chosen symbiont
    CAPTURE --> OUTSIDE_BODY: equal OE, expelled
    CAPTURE --> TERMINAL: lower OE
    CAPTURE --> PRE_REWRITE: greater OE
    PRE_REWRITE --> REWRITING: first 4h sleep
    REWRITING --> COMPANIONS: United host
    COMPANIONS --> PAUSED: stop or equal OE
    PAUSED --> COMPANIONS: resume after OE recovery
    COMPANIONS --> FINAL: explicit final configuration
    REWRITING --> FINAL: Free host or no sequence
    FINAL --> STABLE_HOST: 24h rewrite complete
title: Хранитель: выход, захват, перезапись и Попутчики
